item.content:encoded: Isa Energia Brasil held a hybrid board meeting on Aug. 12, 2026, focusing on changes to the Organizational Talent Committee. item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Darkpulse entered five unsecured promissory notes totaling about $2.78 million, dated Aug. 8, 2026. Borrowings funded a roughly $2.77 million bid deposit tied to a receivership bidding process, with remaining proceeds for transaction costs. item.title: Fermi says Texas data center scrutiny does not affect Project Matador behind-the-meter power plan
item.description: Fermi issued a response backing Texas Gov. Greg Abbott’s directive on data center development, framing power supply as the key constraint. Project Matador
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fermi issued a response backing Texas Gov. Greg Abbott’s directive on data center development, framing power supply as the key constraint. Project Matador is designed as a private, behind-the-meter system, aiming to avoid reliance on the public grid. The commentary said ERCOT is reviewing about 474 gigawatts of grid interconnection requests, with about 90% tied to data centers. Fermi said the directive’s added verification on grid-connected data centers does not affect Matador because it plans on-site, multi-gigawatt generation. The response endorsed tougher standards on development practices, including water use, community impact, ownership transparency, compliance.
